title: Intercompany
description: Pair intercompany orders, invoices and credits between your entities, and find documents that are missing a counterpart or disagree with it.
truncated: Showing the first {count} documents. Narrow the list by entity to see the rest.

unpaired.title: Every intercompany document is paired
unpaired.description: Documents to or from a representing customer or vendor appear here until they are paired with the other entity's counterpart.

mismatched.title: No mismatched pairs
mismatched.description: Pairs whose documents disagree on currency, total or quantities, or where one side was voided, appear here.

paired.title: No paired documents yet
paired.description: Create a counterpart or link an existing document from the Unpaired view.

errors.generateFailed: The counterpart could not be created.
errors.unlinkFailed: The pair could not be unlinked.
errors.linkFailed: The documents could not be linked.
errors.nettingFailed: The netting run could not be updated.
errors.transferFailed: The transfer could not be completed.

pair.unlinkReason: Why are these documents no longer paired?

link.title: Link {document} to a counterpart
link.noCandidates: The other entity has no unpaired document of the matching type for this party.

netting.title: Netting runs
netting.description: Net intercompany receivables and payables between entities as of a date, optionally settle the remainder in cash, and post the result after approval.

empty.title: No netting runs yet
empty.description: Preview a netting run to see what each pair of entities owes the other.

netting.newDescription: Choose the entities and the date. Preview the run before proposing it; the proposal is what gets approved and posted.
netting.cancelReason: Why is this run being cancelled?
netting.reverseReason: Why is this run being reversed?

transfers.title: Intercompany transfers
transfers.description: Move cash from one entity's bank account to another's. Each entity's books balance through the pair's due-to/due-from accounts.

empty.title: No intercompany transfers yet
empty.description: Transfers between bank accounts of the same entity stay in Banking.

transfers.newDescription: The paying entity credits its bank account; the receiving entity debits its bank account. Both accounts must hold the same currency.
transfers.reverseReason: Why is this transfer being reversed?

reconciliation.title: Intercompany reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Each intercompany pair's balances by currency in both entities' ledgers, and the difference left to reconcile.
reconciliation.empty: No intercompany balances as of this date.
